description.value: Surfside Grill is a casual takeout restaurant founded by commercial fisherman Jeff Mikus, operating at Tsawaak RV Resort and Campground near Tin Wis Beach in Tofino. The menu centres on fresh, locally sourced seafood — fish & chips, fish tacos, burgers — with ingredients including BC-farm beef and owner-sourced wild fish. A licensed patio serves a rotating selection of local BC beers, ciders, and wine, and the spot is accessible via beach path from Mackenzie Beach.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active (copyright © 2026) and confirms the business at Tsawaak RV Resort and Campground, 1119 Pacific Rim Hwy, Tofino, with phone 250-725-8299. Takeout is the primary format per the site title 'Tofino Takeout at Surfside Grill' and explicit mention of taking meals to go; the menu confirms vegetarian/vegan and GF options. No bike parking, washroom, pump, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appears on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag shows 09:00 open time, but website contact page states 11:00 am — the OSM tag appears outdated or incorrect.
OSM record has no phone or address tags; phone (250-725-8299) and address (1119 Pacific Rim Hwy) sourced from website only.
OSM tags self_service=yes but website describes a counter-order takeout model — not a true self-service cafeteria; low concern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible takeout restaurant in Tofino with a confirmed website, phone, and address; clearly useful to touring cyclists near Tin Wis Beach.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business is located within Tsawaak RV Resort and Campground; also accessible from beach path from Mackenzie Beach and parking at adjacent Tin Wis Resort.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'Veggie / Vegan' burger and a 'GF bun' upgrade option
